# Create Folder

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Create folder at a path.

## Syntax

~~~~text
createFolder(path: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
createFolder(path: "JellycutsHelper")
~~~~
